title: Alt and Tab Simulation
summary: Given an array of n windows initially ordered, and a series of queries to bring specific windows to the top, return the final order of the windows after applying all queries.
statement: Given an array of n windows initially ordered, and a series of queries to bring specific windows to the top, return the final order of the windows after applying all queries.
constraints: windows is a permutation of 1..n in top-to-bottom order.
Each query moves that window to the top without reordering the others.
hints: Only the final occurrence of each queried window determines recency.
Scan queries backward, keep each window once, then append untouched windows in original order.
Build a seen set and front list from reversed queries; filter windows by seen.
Backward first encounters are decreasing last-use times, while untouched windows retain relative order.
editorial: Backward first encounters are decreasing last-use times, while untouched windows retain relative order.

tests.explanation: Moving 4, then 1, then 3 to the top leaves 3,1,4,2.
